notes:
Two places came back as real finds for those dates. I couldn't confirm a third one, so I left it out.

```json
{
  "picks": [
    {
      "name": "Mini Mondo, Centre des sciences de Montréal (Montréal Science Centre)",
      "age_fit": "Children under 7; the Lair of the Little Ones is made for families with children 0 to 2 years old",
      "when": "Dec 27, 28, 29 and 30, 10:00-17:00 (holiday schedule)",
      "source_name": "Montréal Museums"
    },
    {
      "name": "Biodôme, Espace pour la vie",
      "age_fit": "Children of all ages (family-oriented, stroller-friendly)",
      "when": "Regular hours are Tuesday to Sunday 9:00-17:00. Espace pour la vie lists its museums as open Monday Dec 28 for the holidays, but I did not find that day's hours.",
      "source_name": "Espace pour la vie"
    }
  ]
}
```

- **Science Centre:** 
Mini Mondo is a permanent exhibition for children under 7.
 
It includes the Lair of the Little Ones, made for families with children 0 to 2 years old.
 
The listing's holiday schedule shows Dec 27, 28, 29 and 30 as 10:00 - 17:00.
 Those hours come from the Montréal Museums listing, not the Science Centre's own page. No price turned up.
- **Biodôme:** 
The regular schedule from Sep 2 to Apr 30 is 9:00-17:00, Tuesday to Sunday, with Monday closed.
 
Espace pour la vie's page says its museums will be open on Monday, December 28 (Holidays).
 
Only Dec 24 and 25 are listed as closed.
 The "children of all ages" description comes from 
Tourisme Montréal, which calls it a family-oriented city escape for children of all ages.
 No price turned up.

I did not include the Botanical Garden or Pointe-à-Callière, because I found no December 27 to 30 hours for either.
